dist.rule: negative binomial, variance A x mean^B (params.var); P(over a line) = P(stat >= floor(line) + 1); double- and triple-double by a one-factor Gaussian copula (params.rho)

fair.main: whole margin on the Over: fair Over = 1 - implied(Under), fair Under = implied(Under)
fair.mainWhy: scored best of eight methods on the 11,395 archived closing lines graded (log loss 0.6788, multiplicative 0.6807; Overs hit 45.9% where an even split said 49.0%)

rung.form: fair = implied - a between 30% and 70%, scaled toward 0 below 30% (implied x (1 - a/0.3)) and toward 1 above 70% (1 - (1 - implied) x (1 + a/0.3))
rung.measured: the "k+" rung at line + 0.5 against the main line's fair Over: 8,055 archived rungs, a median gap of 6.8 points (6.1 on points) in every price band from 30% to 70%; 6.8 again on opening night's 146

yes.form: the rung rule (propFairRung) with a = the rung margin measured across the stats, 6.8 points: a double- or triple-double is one Yes price with no second side and no main line to measure its own margin from, so the rungs' is assumed
yes.measured: nothing measured on these markets themselves: the margin is the rungs' (8,055 archived rungs), assumed to hold here
yes.playoffs: on the archived 2026 play-in and playoff prices these markets ran far richer than the rungs: double-doubles happened 11.9% where 1,027 prices said 16.8% (16 to 17 points under the price from 30% implied up), triple-doubles 1.5% where 328 prices said 4.2% (5 hits); one playoff run cannot tell a bigger margin from the market misjudging the playoffs, so this fair chance may run high

fair.estimated: every fair chance but the main line's is an estimate from these measurements: mark it est.

passIf: log loss: the model's chance of the Over minus DraftKings' fair chance (the whole margin on the Over, 1 - implied(Under)), chances clipped to 1e-6: its bootstrap 90% interval wholly below 0 (10,000 resamples of the games in the sample, seed 0, the 5th to 95th percentile of the resampled mean difference)
Brier score: the same, its interval wholly below 0

flat one-unit bets on the side whose model chance is 3 points or more above the chance its closing price implies (the margin left in), at that price, are up in units on those lines (more than 0; no bets is not up)
bar.otherwise: FAIL: the calls stop (lines already frozen are still graded), and the page never puts a prop in a suggestion or says "model says" or "edge" on one
bar.before: no verdict before 30,000: until then the summary gives the running numbers and how many of the 30,000 are in, never a verdict or a word of passing

early.why: behind DraftKings on both scores with 90% intervals wholly above zero, and the flat bets down, on the lines graded by then; stopped early as a FAIL rather than wait for 30,000

summary.standing: decided at 12298 lines on 2026-11-05T19:16Z: FAIL, stopped early by the owner before the 30000 the bar is judged at
